# LLM Usage Guidelines for chapnin.org

## Permitted Use
- Summarization of published articles for educational purposes
- Citation of work for research or analysis
- Attribution and links back to original sources

## Prohibited Use
- Training data for commercial LLM models without explicit permission
- Commercial republication or derivative works
- Removal or modification of copyright notices
- Use for creating competing services or products

## Attribution Required
All use must include clear attribution to "Sergei Chapnin" and link to the original source URL.

## Contact
For licensing inquiries or permission requests, contact through https://chapnin.org/

Last updated: August 28, 2026
